name: Harvesttide
description: Harvesttide is an ancient festival of Kessig, revived by the witches, meant to bring hope and restore the balance between light and darkness.

summary.text: Harvesttide is an ancient festival of Kessig, revived by the witches, meant to bring hope and restore the balance between light and darkness.

bio.text: The festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope, but more people go missing, and Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move.

status.text: The only event recorded for Harvesttide shows it meant to bring hope while more people go missing; the material records nothing further.

timeline.summary: Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move, while the festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope but more people go missing.
timeline.quote: Leinore found the dead snake mixed in the ashes of a campfire gone cold hours ago.

pages_say.description: A traditional humans' celebration of living another year in defiance, which Katilda wants to revive as a ritual.
A festival that Katilda considers necessary to the ritual.
An ancient festival of Kessig, now revived by the witches, meant to bring hope and restore the balance between light and darkness.
The festival ritual that needs the Moonsilver Key.
The festival meant to restore the balance of day and night, attacked by Tovolar's wolves at sunset.
